text: かったら　ダメなのー！

structure.jp: かったら　ダメなのー！

patterns.name: 〜たらだめだ
patterns.explanation: たら means 'if you do', and with ダメ, 'no good', the two together mean 'you must not'. かったら　ダメ = 'you mustn't win'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining or insisting. なの is the soft form used by women and children. ダメなの = 'it's not allowed, I tell you'.
